title: feat(spec): IOwnershipQueueService lets a caller ask for a refusal on a failed member read (onFailedRead)

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLWzy6uXpPjBQbCmtm2Mgpz)_

domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfHeHezsXgrF5MEs4N

Fixes #30251

Part of #29604 (this PR is the contract only; the producer in `plugin-sharing` and the D6/D7 callers that pass `'refuse'` stay with #29604's code half, part 2)

Clause-②: yes (widening: an optional `onFailedRead` on `expandMembers`' options and an optional options argument on `isMember`; precedent PR #30015)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — a call-time option of a kernel service contract that no metadata author writes; `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` name the ownership-queue service but none of its methods (`git grep -n -i "expandMembers|IOwnershipQueueService" -- skills content/docs`: 0 hits)
Prior rulings read: onfailedread,ownership queue,expandmembers → 0 hits; none; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：队列成员服务的契约（`IOwnershipQueueService`）新增一个可选开关 `onFailedRead`，调用方可以说明「成员表读失败时」要的是「当作没人」还是「直接报错」。只改类型和文档注释，不改任何运行逻辑。
- 为什么改：ADR-0142 D2 规定审批人名单（D6）和共享授权重算（D7）遇到读失败必须报错，否则一次数据库故障就会撤掉整个队列给出的授权；但审批插件只能通过这份契约调用队列，原来没有办法表达这个要求。
- 风险与回滚：默认值就是今天的行为（`'nobody'`），所有现有调用和实现原样编译、原样运行；回滚即还原本 PR。真正改行为的是 #29604 的第二部分。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/contracts/ownership-queue-service.ts`（新类型 `OwnershipQueueFailedReadAnswer` 的注释和两个方法签名）、`ownership-queue-failed-read.pin.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:test-typecheck`，预期 OK；pin 文件里四个 `@ts-expect-error` 证明非法取值编译不过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **New exported type `OwnershipQueueFailedReadAnswer = 'nobody' | 'refuse'`** (`@objectstack/spec/contracts`). Its docblock carries the whole rule, citing ADR-0142, D2 "Membership", the amended paragraph "An empty expansion is a fact; a failed read is a fault":
  - the tables behind a queue: `sys_queue`, `sys_queue_member`, `sys_team_member`, `sys_user_position`, `sys_member` through the position transition limb, and the business-unit membership and tree (D2 names the BU reads too, so the list keeps them); a table the composition does not carry is absence, not failure;
  - `'nobody'`: the default and today's answer, logged at `warn`; taken by the access path (D3), the claim admission (D4) and the assignment pool (D5);
  - `'refuse'`: a failed read rejects with a failure that names the read, never `[]`, a partial set or `false`; taken by the approver slate (D6) and the sharing-recipient grant recompute (D7);
  - under either answer an empty queue is still `[]`, and a name that resolves nowhere is still `[]` / `false`;
  - ⛔ independent of `QueueExpansionPurpose` (contract review 6600699486, carried in 6600766777).
- **`expandMembers(name, organizationId, options?: { purpose?; onFailedRead? })`**: the new key sits beside `purpose`; the method docblock points at the type.
- **`isMember(userId, name, organizationId, options?: { onFailedRead? })`**: a new optional trailing argument, so every three-argument call compiles unchanged. Under `'refuse'`, `false` is answered only when every read behind it succeeded.
- **Module header**: one sentence, "A read that FAILS is not absence", pointing at the new type.
- **Generated**: `api-surface/contracts.json` and `export-origins/contracts.json` gain the one new type (`check:generated --fix`, rebuilt dist).
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/spec` `patch` (`Metadata-protocol: none` grades every entry `patch`).

## Caller census

`git grep -n "IOwnershipQueueService\|expandMembers(\|isMember("` at `959c26be`, every hit outside generated JSON and the contract itself:

| site | what it uses | effect of the widening |
|---|---|---|
| `plugin-sharing/src/ownership-queue-service.ts:127` `OwnershipQueueService implements IOwnershipQueueService` | the one implementer; `expandMembers(…, options?: { purpose? })`, `isMember(userId, name, org)` | still assignable (method parameter bivariance; an implementation may take fewer trailing params). Type-checked, see Tests. Behaviour unchanged: it ignores the key until #29604 part 2 |
| `plugin-sharing/src/sharing-rule-service.ts:432, :1747, :2186` (D7) | `Pick` of 'expandMembers' \| 'isMember', calls without options | compiles unchanged; these are the call sites #29604 part 2 moves to `'refuse'` |
| `plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts:557, :952` (D3) | `Pick` of 'queuesOf' \| 'isMember', 3-arg `isMember` | unchanged, default `'nobody'` |
| `plugin-sharing/src/index.ts:177` | type re-export | unchanged |
| `plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts:1638, :3347` (D6) | `Pick` of 'expandMembers', `{ purpose: 'addressing' }` | compiles unchanged; #29604 part 2 adds `onFailedRead: 'refuse'` here |
| `objectql/src/assignment-rules.ts:74, :293` (D5) | `Pick` of 'resolveQueue' \| 'expandMembers', 2-arg call | unchanged, default `'nobody'` |
| `plugin-security/src/ownership-queue-gate.ts:32`, `security-plugin.ts:2670`, `security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts:1602` (D4), `security-plugin-explain-access.ts:253, :512` | `Pick` of 'resolveQueue' \| 'isMember', 3-arg `isMember` | unchanged |
| `plugin-security/src/kernel-queue-membership.ts:44`, `security-plugin.ts:2683` | `Pick` of 'queuesOf' | member untouched |
| `plugin-hono-server/src/current-user-endpoints.ts:317` | `Pick` of 'hasAnyQueue' | member untouched |
| `runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts:166` | `Pick` of 'declaredQueueNamed' | member untouched |
| tests: `plugin-sharing/src/ownership-queue.test.ts`, `plugin-security/src/kernel-queue-membership.test.ts:113` | calls without options | compile unchanged |

No caller breaks: the key is optional on an options bag that was already optional, and the `isMember` argument is a new optional trailing one.

## Tests

- New `packages/spec/src/contracts/ownership-queue-failed-read.pin.test.ts`, compiled by `check:test-typecheck` under `tsconfig.test.json`:
  - type-level `Assert`/`Eq` pins: the answer type is exactly `'nobody' | 'refuse'`; both members' `onFailedRead` read it; `expandMembers`' option keys are exactly `purpose | onFailedRead` and `isMember`'s exactly `onFailedRead`; `purpose` keeps its type; the two value sets are disjoint;
  - an implementation written before the key (`expandMembers` with `{ purpose? }` only, a 3-param `isMember`) is still an `IOwnershipQueueService`;
  - call shapes that compile: no options, `{}`, `{ purpose }`, `{ onFailedRead: 'refuse' }`, both keys, the 3-arg and 4-arg `isMember`;
  - four `@ts-expect-error` shapes that must not compile: `onFailedRead: 'throw'`, `'empty'`, `'addressing'`, and `purpose` on `isMember`;
  - one runtime case, so vitest counts the file.

<details><summary>Reverse verification (two mutations, each restored by scripts/ablation-replace.mjs to the HEAD blob)</summary>

- Mutation 1: delete `isMember`'s `options?: { onFailedRead?: OwnershipQueueFailedReadAnswer },` → `check:test-typecheck` red, `ownership-queue-failed-read.pin.test.ts: 4 type error(s)`; restored, blob `2bd06d9682c3` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Mutation 2: widen the type to `'nobody' | 'refuse' | 'throw'` → red, `2 type error(s)` (the `Eq` pin and the now-unused `@ts-expect-error`); restored, blob == HEAD.

Both read through `tsconfig.test.json`, which resolves the contract from `src`, so no dist rebuild was needed for the legs.
</details>

Local runs, all on head `12fb7d30`, each under `os-verify-lock` with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (tsc, scripts, `check:test-typecheck`) and the new pin file: VERDICT command-exit 0; `Test Files 1 passed (1)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: VERDICT command-exit 0; `Test Files 813 passed (813)`, `Tests 25576 passed | 1 todo (25577)`.
- Downstream (the contract's import side, `^...` closure built first, 36 turbo tasks): `typecheck` of `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` (the implementer), `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`, `@objectstack/plugin-security` and `@objectstack/objectql`: VERDICT command-exit 0, each `check:test-typecheck: OK`. `plugin-hono-server` and `runtime` pick only `hasAnyQueue` / `declaredQueueNamed`, members this PR does not touch, so they were not re-typechecked (CI's full typecheck covers them).
- `check:generated --fix` rebuilt `packages/spec/dist` and regenerated `api-surface/` and `export-origins/` (the two artifacts it proved stale); a later plain `check:generated` is green.

## Acceptance notes

- The activation-ledger read (`switchedOff`, answered "on" when its read fails) is not named in the new docblock: contract review 6600766777 leaves that posture for #29604's code half to decide and say.
- `queuesOf` gets no `onFailedRead`: no ADR-0142 recompute consumer reads it, and the card does not ask for it.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 80 families at `12fb7d30`; all 80 ran, every one exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: `80 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 80 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- Three first-pass non-zero exits, each a local prerequisite and re-run green on the same head:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3: shallow clone missing the pinned fixture commit; fetched it, then exit 0 (48 cases pass);
  - `spec check:generated` exit 1: the runner had no `NODE_OPTIONS`, and `check:test-typecheck`'s tsc ran out of the default 2 GB heap; re-run with 4 GB, exit 0;
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (no dist for 38 packages); after a full `turbo run build` (120 tasks), exit 0: 116 require entry points across 71 packages load.
- `check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main` exit 0 with the `@objectstack/spec` `patch` entry under `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- Repo-wide lint and `test:repo` are CI's runs.
